approval_scope: current forward recovery only; this does not retroactively approve the historical A2B materialization
approval_rationale: The six topology clusters are shared lifecycle/observation/transaction/runner/normalization failure causes that fit the clean provider architecture rather than ten unrelated resource-specific bugs.
The 28 manifestations span identity/state, drift refresh, failed update retry, scoped delete, process safety and normalization across multiple managed-resource families.
The topology contains explicit causal edges and partial-fix traps, so difficulty derives from coupled production invariants rather than fixture variation or numeric padding.
The topology does not require hidden fixture constants, Oracle implementation details or verifier-body knowledge to understand the intended external behavior.

The current targeted complexity validator independently confirms the topology shape remains within the strict 20-30 manifestation / fewer-root-cause model; fresh post-approval machine evidence is required before A2B is recorded complete.

historical_provenance.recovery_rule: Do not treat the original A2B as approved. Re-run ENVIRONMENT_BUILD after this approval and re-earn downstream current evidence.
